answer: Charge every identity a refundable bond at least as large as one epoch of expected emission, slashed if a majority of independent attestors reject its answers, and withdrawable only after two epochs of clean history. New arrivals wait at a jetty until the bond is posted and cannot mine or vote until it clears, so unpaid fakes never enter the pool.
